title: Version Control for Scientific Reasoning: A Paradigm Shift from Artifacts to Processes

contributions.purpose: 提出把科研当版本化计算过程的Scientific DSL
contributions.mechanism: 形式化8种研究操作(observe/question/hypothesize/design/execute/analyze/synthesize/communicate),置于DAG研究状态机,含genealogical tracking与把冲突作为一等公民
contributions.evaluation: 定性:给出状态机与操作的操作性定义,无形式化定理(theory checklist答NA)
contributions.domain: 科研可复现/科研工作流管理
contributions.source_quote: Our contribution is a Scientific Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that formalizes research operations within a comprehensive framework

contributions.purpose: 以多智能体架构解决AI验证悖论并实现科学CI
contributions.mechanism: 各研究阶段专用AI agent+多尺度验证(计算/方法学/认识论人工监督/可复现),用GitHub Actions做hypothesis-as-commit的持续集成
contributions.evaluation: 定性:架构描述,无对照实验(自称position paper)
contributions.source_quote: The system addresses the AI validation paradox through multi-scale validation... continuous integration pipelines where hypotheses function as commits

contributions.purpose: 用语法化案例研究示范框架
contributions.mechanism: 对合作住房社区'daha/dawa'语法化研究跑完整流水线,统计版本化数据与归因
contributions.evaluation: 声称:20假设/35论文/9400+消息/127 commits跨7阶段,'发现显著差异'但未给任何p值或效应量;Table 1为纯定性对比(paper-level vs commit-level)无数字
contributions.source_quote: Results found significant differences in grammaticalization patterns between cooperative and traditional housing, with complete reproducibility... Attribution tracking captured 127 commits across seven research stages

self_declared_provenance.quote: GitHub for laboratory research [2] successfully demonstrates practical version control application but assumes research follows software development patterns, missing hypothesis evolution tracking essential for scientific reasoning.

notes: position paper,协议适配问题:'Experimental Validation'章节数据空洞——Table 1全定性无数字,案例研究只说'significant differences'却无统计量,却对reproducibility/experimental setting/compute均答[Yes]、statistical significance答[NA],声称与内容不符(数据可信度红旗)。参考文献格式可疑(多个'et al. Furrer'、'Beber. 2025'等非正式条目)。AI自披露突出:写作[D](~90%AI)、分析[D],作者自承'AI's tendency to make over-claims and elaborate concepts beyond the initial scope'、需'repeated revision cycles to maintain appropriate claims'——即AI倾向夸大主张。3条贡献按abstract声明(DSL/多智能体架构/案例验证)归纳。
